title: AI Screenshot Cleaner
script: My screenshots folder is a mess. I asked AI to build a cleaner. Six categories, readable names, and a preview before anything changes. The app has to handle duplicates and keep the original files recoverable. I checked every image against labels written before the test. [CORRECT_CLASSIFICATIONS] were correct. Here is [REAL_MISTAKE_OR_EDGE_CASE]. [PRACTICAL_LIMITATION]. What annoying folder task should I automate next?
timingStatus: Aligned to actual Voicebox recording with local recognized word timestamps. Minor unrecognized tokens interpolate between recognized neighbors.
concept: Vision-assisted rename/classification of twenty sample screenshots.
whyNow: AI coding and automation promises are judged by a reproducible useful task.
viewerGoal: Understand what the system actually completed and where supervision matters.
hooks: My screenshots folder is a mess. I asked AI to build a cleaner.
Twenty screenshots. Six categories. How many mistakes?
Before AI renames anything, I want a preview.
strongestHook: My screenshots folder is a mess. I asked AI to build a cleaner.
directorBrief: Direct this as an observable challenge: Vision-assisted rename/classification of twenty sample screenshots. The viewer must see the starting problem, the exact constraint, one revealing action and the independently checked output. Let the real failure or correction create the turn. Save every first attempt. Completion claims alone never establish a result.
effort: 60–90 minutes core experiment; allow additional audit/edit time.
protocol: Prepare copies of 20 original or non-sensitive screenshots; keep untouched originals separately. Pre-label code, design, receipt, chat, game or other, including two duplicates and ambiguous examples. Build a classifier with rename preview, explicit Apply step, duplicate-safe suffixes and a rollback mapping. Audit all 20 labels and names; confirm original files remain intact and no rename collisions. Capture a real mistake or ambiguity, not a perfect fictional result.
evidenceRequirements: Use copies; audit true classifications and show mistakes.
thumbnailDirection: Use the opening object or strongest real evidence crop. Put “Screenshot Folder Rescue” in the top-middle safe area; one accent, no extra subheading.
ending: [PRACTICAL_LIMITATION]. What annoying folder task should I automate next?
instagramCaption: AI Screenshot Cleaner. Vision-assisted rename/classification of twenty sample screenshots. Full test conditions and limitations belong beside the final result. [PRACTICAL_LIMITATION]. What annoying folder task should I automate next?
tiktokCaption: AI Screenshot Cleaner. WHAT SHOULD I AUTOMATE?
music: Original/licensed light percussive electronic bed, 100–115 BPM; leave real clicks readable. No music asset is included.
recordings: Full continuous source run plus selected genuine action clips. Record 1080p or higher, readable UI, cursor, exact OS/tool/plan and run clock. Keep uncropped originals.
screenshots: Baseline, first attempt, final output, official license/plan/version, and each verdict evidence frame. Synthetic fixtures only.
icons: Use original vector shapes and existing studio-kit Icon components; use official product marks only for identification. No random decorative icon grid.
assetBrief: Before/after folder, real build, app, sample images.
